title: PEEF Master Level Scholarships (Master Level)
description: The PEEF allocated  annual scholarship quota for Master's Level Education. These scholarships are awarded to talented and deserving students enrolled in partner universities. The minimum eligibility criteria for consideration of PEEF Master’s level scholarship is given below:
eligibilityCriteria: Punjab domicile.

Secured at least 60% marks or a minimum CGPA 2.5 in graduation level examination held in 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 (fall/spring sessions) from Punjab (minimum sixteen years of schooling or 4-year education after HSSC / F.A / F. Sc / Grade 12 examination).

Secured admission as a full-time student in the current academic year (2025-26) in one of the partner universities/degree-awarding institutions.
	
Students enrolled in fall/spring sessions (where applicable) and morning/ afternoon/ evening sessions (where applicable) are eligible to apply for the PEEF Master’s level scholarship.
Students enrolled in fall/spring sessions (where applicable) and morning/ afternoon/ evening sessions (where applicable) are eligible to apply for the PEEF Master’s level scholarship.

Declared monthly income of parents (from all sources) is equal to or less than sixty thousand (Rs. 60,000/-).
	
Children of Govt. employees in BPS 1-4 are exempted from condition of monthly income, if salary is the only source of income
Children of civilians martyred in terrorist attacks are exempted from condition of monthly income.

title: PEEF Outreach and Special Quota Scholarships (Outreach)
description: The PEEF has allocated 80% of its annual scholarships for under "Outreach Scholarships" category. These scholarships are awarded to needy & talented students to pursue higher education for studies in the following two (2) educational levels.
eligibilityCriteria: Passed Matriculation OR Intermediate annual examination held by Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE) Punjab or Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (FBISE), Islamabad in annual.
Only students of Federal Government Institutions and Federal Private affiliated institutions situated within geographical boundaries of Punjab are eligible.
Declared monthly income of parents (from all sources) is equal to or less than PKR. 60,000/- .

For Special Quota Scholarships, the student must fall in at least one of the S.Q categories.
	
Orphans
Children of government employees of BPS 1-4 (Children of Both Serving and Retired Govt. servants are eligible )
Children belonging to minority religion
Special Children (Disabled)
The Children of civilians martyred in terrorist's attacks
Children of divorced mothers
Children of government employees of BPS 1-4 (Children of Both Serving and Retired Govt. servants are eligible )
Children belonging to minority religion

title: PEEF Outreach and Special Quota Scholarships (Special Quota)
description: PEEF has allocated 20% of its total scholarships to Special Quota(SQ) category. The Special Quota Scholarships are awarded under five categories.
eligibilityCriteria: Children of government employees of BPS 1-4 (Children of Both Serving and Retired Govt. servants are eligible )
Children belonging to minority religion
Special Children (Disabled)
The Children of civilians martyred in terrorist's attacks
Children of divorced mothers
Newspaper advertisement is released and applications are invited from students to apply online with in due date.

title: PEEF Additional Scholarships (Scholarships for Other Provinces)
description: The Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF) has allocated special scholarship quotas for talented and needy students of other provinces, AJK, Gilgit Baltistan and Islamabad Capital Territory. These scholarships are awarded to the pass outs of public sector institutions to pursue Intermediate, Graduation and Master's level education in their respective province or any other educational institution of Pakistan.
eligibilityCriteria: The provincial / territory / domicile
Passed Matriculation or Intermediate Examination held in annual by the respective Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education
Scored at least 60% marks in the above mentioned examination
Secured admission in a regular educational institution as a fulltime student in the same year as of passing the examination
Passed these examinations from Government Institution of respective province / territory.
Monthly income of parents (from all sources) is equal to or less than Rs. 60,000/-

title: PEEF Additional Scholarships (Punjab Board of Technical Education)
description:
The PEEF for the year 2025-26 has allocated a quota of 468 scholarships for the students of Punjab Board of Technical Education (PBTE). This quota includes both Outreach and Special Quota Scholarships. Quota has been allocated irrespective of gender of students.
Scholarship allocation for the year 2025-26 is as under:
eligibilityCriteria: Passed Matric -Tech., Commercial and Technical PBTE examination in Annual from Govt. Institution or Private Affiliated Institutions
Secured at least 60% marks in the above mentioned examination
Secured admission in a regular educational institution as a full time student in the same academic year as of passing examination
Monthly income of parents (from all sources) is equal to or less than PKR. 60,000/-
The children of government servants in BPS 1 - 4 are exempted from income limit criteria if salary is the only source of income

For Special Quota Scholarships, the student must fall in at least one of the following S.Q categories:
	
Orphan Children
Children of government servants in BPS 1 - 4
Children belonging to minority religion
Special Children
The Children civilians martyred in terrorist's attacks
Children of divorced mothers

title: PEEF Additional Scholarships (Center of Excellence)
description: Center of Excellence (COE) is defined as academic institutions that have achieved high merit in the academic realm in terms of reputation, conduct and performance. The Punjab Educational Endowment Fund has allocated scholarship quotas to different COEs. The responsibility of selection of students for PEEF scholarship rests with the respective COE.
eligibilityCriteria: Must have Punjab domicile.
Scored at least 60% marks in his / her previous examination (in annual) from BISEs of Punjab.

Passed the examination as a regular student from:
	
Government Institution, or Continuing scholar of the respective institution
As a Private Candidate or
Private Institution
Government Institution, or Continuing scholar of the respective institution
As a Private Candidate or
